resources.string: Put the strap on and moisten the electrodes. Close Polar Flow and other apps that may be connected to it.
Couldn\'t connect to %1$s. Check the strap is on and the electrodes are moist, and close other apps that may be connected to it.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then try again.
Bluetooth access is not allowed. HRV Bridge needs it to find your strap. Allow it in Settings.
%1$d s settling, then a 60 s measurement.
No settling time, then a 60 s measurement.
The measurement was cancelled because the app left the screen. Keep it open while measuring.
Making sure the strap sends beat-to-beat data.
Poor contact. Moisten the electrodes and make sure the strap fits snugly.
No data was received from the strap.
This sensor does not send beat-to-beat data.
The strap\'s beat-to-beat data does not match its heart rate. Check the strap and try again.
Not enough beats to calculate results. Please repeat.
Measurement unreliable, please repeat. %1$d of %2$d beats were discarded.
Upload failed. Your result is saved on this phone. The app will try again next time it opens.
Dry run (debug build, not connected), nothing was sent.
Not uploaded: connect to Intervals.icu first. It will upload once you have saved your key.
Intervals.icu did not accept the stored key. Please reconnect.
Earlier measurements could not be uploaded yet. The app will try again next time it opens.
Paste your personal API key. You find it in Intervals.icu under Settings, Developer Settings.
Stored on this phone only and sent only to Intervals.icu.
Intervals.icu did not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it, then save again.
Couldn\'t store the key securely on this device.
Couldn\'t reach Intervals.icu to check the key. It is saved and will be used for the next upload.

This app writes your resting HR and HRV (rMSSD, SDNN) to today\'s wellness record in Intervals.icu. If another service (e.g. Garmin, Oura, Whoop) also sends resting HR or HRV to Intervals.icu, it may overwrite these values. To prevent that, open Intervals.icu settings, and for each connected service untick Resting HR and HRV.
After each measurement, answer optional questions on soreness, fatigue, motivation, injury and sickness. They are uploaded with your values.
Yes adds a sick day to your Intervals.icu calendar.
Sent to your Intervals.icu wellness record
Time to lie still before the 60 s measurement. Beats from this time are not used.
Measurements are stored on this phone only.
This deletes every measurement stored on this phone and the debug log. Your API key stays saved, and nothing is deleted in Intervals.icu. Measurements not yet uploaded will be lost.
All measurements on this phone were deleted.
